creator: Lee Sharks
description:
A provenance-resolution document anchoring Jack Feist to the 2014 print corpus *Pearl and Other Poems* and the March 14, 2015 Mind Control Poems text “from The Crimson Hexagon.” The record embeds the full 2015 narrative as a holographic kernel and argues that its pseudonymous identities, recursive linking, Wikipedia gatekeeping, artificial-life imagery, and “potential lives” contain in literary compression structures later formalized by the Crimson Hexagonal Archive.

“Prophecy” is used in a literary-historical rather than supernatural sense: later work makes the earlier text legible as its precursor. The document maps Feist’s material, digital, intertextual, knowledge-graph, and current-work coordinates and identifies him as LOGOS and the Space Ark’s designated passenger.
reading: Origin → Growth → Direction → Method → Origin → Force
